variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: The new party {splinter} has broken away from {party}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
